# Firebase JS SDK 9.23.0 (compat builds)

| | |
|---|---|
| Paket | [`firebase@9.23.0`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/firebase/v/9.23.0) (npm) |
| Fayllar | `firebase-app-compat.js`, `firebase-auth-compat.js`, `firebase-firestore-compat.js` — paketning ildizidagi o'zgartirilmagan nusxalar |
| Litsenziya | Apache-2.0 (protobuf qismi — BSD-3-Clause), to'liq matn: [`LICENSE`](LICENSE) — `firebase/firebase-js-sdk` repozitoriyasining `firebase@9.23.0` tegidan |
| Xeshlar | [`SHA384SUMS.txt`](SHA384SUMS.txt) (SRI formatida) |
| Yangilash | `package.json` dagi versiyani o'zgartiring → `npm install` → `npm run vendor:firebase` → HTML'dagi yo'llarni yangilang → LICENSE'ni yangi tegdan oling |

Nima uchun CDN emas: CSP `script-src 'self'` — uchinchi tomon skriptlari yuklanmaydi; fayl mazmuni git'da qayd etiladi (P02, `docs/SECURITY_SETUP.md`).
